title: Design System: Nguyen Phu Trieu Portfolio

meta.purpose: Dates, indices, categories, and technical labels.

motion.name: folio-arrive
motion.purpose: A single clipped, slightly blurred upward arrival for the hero copy and deployment sheet; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: state-feedback
motion.purpose: Color, background, border, shadow, transform, and active-rule feedback only on fine hover pointers; removed under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The manifest-gradient action used for the highest-value route on a surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { align-items: center; background: var(--manifest); border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--accent-ink); display: inline-flex; font-family: var(--font-be-vietnam-pro), sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.1rem; padding: 0 1.2rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-button-primary { transition: color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Action
components.description: A quiet secondary action on a folio-sheet field.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { align-items: center; background: var(--sheet); border: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); display: inline-flex; font-family: var(--font-be-vietnam-pro), sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.1rem; padding: 0 1.2rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--blue); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-button-ghost { transition: color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-ghost { transition: none; } }

components.name: Square Icon Control
components.description: A square outlined utility control for theme or repository access.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-control" type="button" aria-label="Switch theme"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.42 1.42M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.93 19.07l1.42-1.42M17.66 6.34l1.41-1.41"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-control { align-items: center; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; height: 2.75rem; justify-content: center; padding: 0; width: 2.75rem; } .ds-icon-control:hover { border-color: var(--blue); color: var(--ink); } .ds-icon-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-icon-control svg { fill: none; height: 1.15rem; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; width: 1.15rem; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-icon-control { transition: color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-icon-control { transition: none; } }

components.name: Language Selector
components.description: The compact square bilingual segmented control shown in global navigation.
components.css: .ds-language { border: 1px solid var(--rule); display: flex; padding: 0.15rem; } .ds-language button { background: transparent; border: 0; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-be-vietnam-pro), sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; min-height: 2.45rem; min-width: 2.15rem; padding: 0.4rem; } .ds-language button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-language button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-language button { transition: color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-language button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Technology Tag
components.description: A non-interactive square metadata label for technologies and article topics.
components.css: .ds-tag { border: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--muted); display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-be-vietnam-pro), sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 0.38rem 0.55rem; }

components.name: Manifest Sheet
components.description: The clipped blue-violet document field used for concentrated identity and evidence.
components.css: .ds-manifest { background: var(--manifest); clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 2rem) 0, 100% 2rem, 100% 100%, 0 100%); color: var(--accent-ink); font-family: var(--font-be-vietnam-pro), sans-serif; max-width: 30rem; padding: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.4rem); position: relative; } .ds-manifest::after { border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 45%); border-left: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 45%); content: ""; height: 2rem; position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; width: 2rem; } .ds-manifest-head { border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 30%); display: flex; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; justify-content: space-between; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-manifest > p { font-size: 0.8rem; margin: 1.5rem 0 0; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-manifest > strong { display: block; font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 5vw, 5rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 0.92; margin: 1.8rem 0 2.2rem; } .ds-manifest dl { margin: 0; } .ds-manifest dl div { align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 25%); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.8rem 0; } .ds-manifest dt { font-size: 0.88rem; opacity: 0.75; } .ds-manifest dd { font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; text-align: right; }

components.css: .ds-project-row { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); display: grid; font-family: var(--font-be-vietnam-pro), sans-serif; gap: 1.4rem; grid-template-columns: 3rem minmax(0, 1fr); padding: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.4rem) 0; } .ds-project-index { color: var(--blue); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 800; grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 4; padding-top: 0.2rem; } .ds-project-row > header { color: var(--muted); display: flex; font-size: 0.78rem; gap: 1rem; grid-column: 2; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-project-row > header span:first-child { color: var(--blue); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-project-body, .ds-project-tags, .ds-project-row > a { grid-column: 2; } .ds-project-body h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3.8rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1.02; margin: 0; } .ds-project-body p { color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.72; margin: 1.1rem 0 0; max-width: 68ch; } .ds-project-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-project-tags span { border: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 0.38rem 0.55rem; } .ds-project-row > a { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--blue); color: var(--ink); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; justify-self: start; padding-bottom: 0.25rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-project-row > a:hover { color: var(--blue); } .ds-project-row > a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (min-width: 64rem) { .ds-project-row { grid-template-columns: 4rem minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(16rem, 0.75fr); } .ds-project-index { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 3; } .ds-project-row > header { grid-column: 2 / 4; } .ds-project-body { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2 / span 2; } .ds-project-tags { align-content: start; grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2; } .ds-project-row > a { align-self: end; grid-column: 3; grid-row: 3; } }

components.name: Active Navigation Link
components.description: A muted navigation label whose active state is marked by a manifest registration rule.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { align-items: center; color: var(--muted); display: inline-flex; font-family: var(--font-be-vietnam-pro), sans-serif; font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 600; min-height: 2.75rem; position: relative; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link::after { background: var(--manifest); bottom: -0.6rem; content: ""; height: 3px; left: 0; position: absolute; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; width: 100%; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-nav-link { transition: color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link::after { transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-link, .ds-nav-link::after { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio behaves like a precise technical folio: cool paper fields, registration rules, clipped deployment sheets, and evidence arranged for fast inspection. It is editorial rather than dashboard-like, giving recruiters and technical reviewers a clear path from career statement to verified experience, projects, writing, repositories, and contact.

The system is dense but calm. Be Vietnam Pro carries every role, including Vietnamese copy, while strong weight contrast and restrained blue-to-ultraviolet fields create hierarchy. Dark and light themes preserve the same document logic; neither becomes a neon control panel or a generic card grid.
keyCharacteristics: Infrastructure evidence presented as an editorial change-set.
Cool paper and ink surfaces in paired dark and light themes.
Cobalt-to-ultraviolet manifest fields used as structural emphasis.
Square controls, clipped sheets, fine rules, and numbered rows.
Bilingual typography with compact metadata and oversized headlines.
Motion limited to purposeful arrival and hover feedback.

rules.name: The Manifest Rarity Rule
rules.body: Use the blue-to-ultraviolet field for a primary action or a document-like focal sheet, never as a routine headline fill.

rules.name: The Theme Equivalence Rule
rules.body: Theme switching changes material values, not hierarchy, component geometry, or information order.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Keep all Latin and Vietnamese text in Be Vietnam Pro; do not introduce a display face that weakens bilingual continuity.

rules.name: The Evidence Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Oversized type states the claim, normal-weight body text supplies evidence, and compact labels identify system metadata.

rules.name: The Scanline Rule
rules.body: Align evidence to rows and rules; do not convert project, experience, or article indexes into floating card mosaics.

rules.name: The Mobile Priority Rule
rules.body: Preserve primary destinations, language, theme, and repository access before decorative brand text.

rules.name: The Constructed Depth Rule
rules.body: Build depth with offset sheets, rules, clipping, and tonal layering; do not add soft card shadows or glass effects.

rules.name: The No-Radius Rule
rules.body: Keep interactive and content containers square; do not round buttons, tags, controls, or panels.

rules.name: The Clipped-Manifest Rule
rules.body: Use the cut corner only on blue-violet document fields that carry concentrated identity or evidence.

dos: Do use Be Vietnam Pro for every language and typographic role.
Do preserve square controls, clipped manifest sheets, and one-pixel registration rules.
Do keep project, experience, and blog content in flat editorial rows.
Do reserve manifest gradients and blue emphasis for primary actions, focal sheets, indices, and state feedback.
Do keep visible cyan keyboard focus and remove nonessential motion under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Do collapse grids and brand text at the established mobile breakpoints while preserving core navigation and controls.
donts: Don't turn the portfolio into a dark neon DevOps dashboard.
Don't introduce rounded cards, pills, soft drop shadows, glassmorphism, or floating card grids.
Don't apply the manifest gradient to every heading or decorative surface.
Don't add ornamental motion beyond purposeful arrival and fine-pointer state feedback.
Don't hide language, theme, project, blog, or repository access to protect decorative space.
